text: The fixpoint combinator Y = λf.(λx.f(xx))(λx.f(xx)) is NOT typeable in STLC because:
choices: typing it would require a type T satisfying T = T→T, which has no solution in STLC
explanation: Y requires T=T→T (self-application xx:T where x:T→T and x:T). STLC has no such recursive type; Y is typeable in recursive type systems or with explicit fixpoint operators.
